crossRefs.note: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who…
However there was no accounting made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand; for they dealt…
Whoever will not do the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed on him with all diligence…
Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

translations.web: Whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, do that according to the will of your God.
translations.bsb: You and your brothers may do whatever seems best with the rest of the silver and gold, according to the will of your God.
translations.kjv: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.
translations.asv: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee and to thy brethren to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do ye after the will of your God.
